verdict.rationale: The Florida Department of Revenue runs electronic filing and payment services, and a service like this could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web login applications, XML schemas, and batch enrollment files that must be requested by email. These are submission formats and building blocks, not an official command-line tool, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
